text: Arsenic levels dangerously high in drinking water. Children showing skin lesions and falling sick.
Death reported near Chas borewell. Villagers consumed contaminated water with toxic levels.
Cholera outbreak in Sahibganj village. Multiple hospitalisations. PHC has no medicines.
Malaria outbreak near Chaibasa. No anti-malarial drugs at health centre. Cases rising fast.
River contamination causing acute illness outbreak. Multiple families affected in downstream village.
Fatal accident at collapsed bridge near Seraikela. Vehicle fell. No warning sign installed.
Epidemic risk from stagnant water after flood. No disease surveillance team deployed.
Arsenic contamination reported in tubewell water at Chas block. No safe water alternative.
Emergency: borewell pump collapsed. 200 families without water during heatwave.
Toxic mine water discharge into river. Fishing communities showing acute symptoms.
Flood waters mixing with sewage in Sahebganj. Waterborne disease risk very high.
Dengue cases doubling every week in Ramgarh. Fogging not done. No beds in hospital.
Maternal death occurred due to delay. Ambulance took 4 hours. Road broken.
Drought has completely destroyed kharif crop in Palamu. Farmers have nothing to eat.
Pregnant woman could not reach hospital. Road flooded. Delivered at home without help.
Contamination from factory effluent affecting drinking water source of 5 villages.
Malaria case at PHC not referred on time. Patient now in severe condition.
Flood damaged road cutting off our village for 6 days. No emergency supply reached.
TB patient has stopped taking medicine due to distance. Condition is worsening.
Toxic fumes from coal mine ventilation shaft near school. Students complaining of dizziness.
Anemia very high among pregnant women in our block. Supplements out of stock for 2 months.
Water turbidity very high from treatment plant. Chlorine shortage disrupted supply.
Crop failure due to untimely rainfall. Farmers requesting drought relief urgently.
Dengue surveillance absent in our municipality. Mosquito breeding sites not cleared.
Broken bridge making transport impossible for 3 villages since last monsoon.
Food shortage in tribal hamlet. ICDS food supply disrupted for 6 weeks.
Fluoride in groundwater causing dental and skeletal fluorosis in villagers.
High tension electric wire snapped and lying on road. Risk of electrocution.
Pollution from stone crusher causing respiratory illness in children near school.
Open drain overflowing into homes during rain. Health hazard for 30 families.
Irrigation canal broken for 3 months. Paddy crop will fail if not repaired now.
Power outage affecting cold storage. Vaccine spoilage risk at sub-centre.
Failure of solar pumps affecting water supply to 4 schools and 1 PHC.
Maternal health services disrupted as ANM absent for 2 months in our block.
Sand mining causing riverbank erosion. Houses on bank at risk of falling.
Shortage of medicines at PHC for common diseases. Patients buying from private shops.
Government school has no teacher for 2 months. Board exams approaching.
Paddy yield down 40 percent due to pest attack. No extension officer visited.
Pothole on highway caused vehicle accident. No repair in 3 months.
Road needs urgent repair. Ambulance could not reach patient in time due to bad road.
Electricity transformer failed. 8 villages without power during winter.
Sewage plant non-functional for 4 months. Untreated waste going to river.
Forest fire not controlled for 2 days. Large area of forest burned.
Contaminated water from broken pipe mixing with supply. Complaints ignored.
Deforestation near wildlife corridor happening unchecked. Elephants displaced.
School building unsafe after cracks visible. Students sitting in damaged rooms.
Doctor absent at PHC. Patients turned away without treatment.
Septic tank overflowing near primary school. Waste visible on playground.
Soil acidity in Kanke block making crops fail. Lime subsidy not given.
Tubewell pump needs maintenance. Water supply disrupted for 2 days.
Cold storage broken. Some vegetable produce rotting.
Electricity available only 6 hours per day in our area. Supply very unreliable.
Girls dropout rate increasing. No toilet in upper primary school.
Garbage collection vehicle not coming for 3 weeks. Waste piling up.
Community toilet locked most of the time. No caretaker.
LPG delivery delayed by 3 weeks in remote area. Families using firewood.
Digital literacy programme has no equipment delivered yet.
Forest patrols reporting poaching activity in Palamau reserve.
Irrigation pump needs repair. Farmers cannot water fields.
Scholarship not credited to tribal students for 2 semesters.
Biomass gasifier installed but not operational. No training given.
Street lights in our ward not working since 2 months. Safety concern.
Mid-day meal quality is poor at our school. Children complaining.
Garbage bins not emptied regularly. Flies breeding at the site.
Soil testing lab not functional. Farmers cannot get health card.
Water meter faulty. Getting high bills despite low usage.
Road has a few potholes but overall passable. Needs resurfacing.
Computer lab installed but internet connection not given yet.
Biogas plant producing less gas than expected. Needs maintenance check.
Bus service to our block is not frequent. Waiting time too long.
LPG recharge kiosk far from our village. Inconvenience for residents.
Building maintenance of community hall needed. Roof needs minor repair.
Dustbin in market area overflowing. Needs bigger container.
School blackboard is old and needs replacement.
Library needs more books on competitive exams.
Solar panel on streetlight has minor dust accumulation. Needs cleaning.
Road marking not visible on main road. Needs repainting.
Anganwadi centre needs a new mat and some classroom equipment.
Wire fencing of government tree nursery is broken in one section.
EV charging station progress is slow. Expected 2 months ago.
Community toilet needs soap and water availability improvement.
Old water tank needs repainting and general maintenance.
Forest nursery needs additional seedlings this season.
District library timings could be extended for working students.
Footpath in colony needs better paving. Slightly uneven.
Agricultural fair should be organised more frequently in our block.
Suggestion to add more routes to mobile library van.
Request for additional variety of seeds at cooperative store.
